column1: # SpoolmanScale - width budgets for the translated strings
# Tab separated: StringID <TAB> font <TAB> budget in px <TAB> mode <TAB> site
# Why this file exists. Only 146 of the 743 T() call sites have a shape a script
# can follow back to a widget width, so the widths cannot be harvested. The
# general rule the checker applies instead needs no widths at all: French must
# not be wider than the wider of German and English, because upstream already
# made every layout fit both. This file is for the places where that rule is not
# enough - either because the real budget is known and larger, or because the
# failure mode is silent and we want a hard gate.
#   NEVER   must fit, no ellipsis allowed. fit_check --gate fails on these.
#   DOT     may ellipsise (a spool name, an address) - not gated.
#   WRAP:n  may wrap to at most n lines.
# It lives in tools/ so it is never compiled and upstream never sees a conflict
# --- THE BUTTON RULE, arrived at by measuring against real screenshots --------
# A label inside a button is CLIPPED at the button's own width, not at its
# content box: "Plus d'infos" is 69 px in an 84 px button whose theme padding
# would leave only 50, and it renders perfectly. lv_obj_center() centres on the
# full area, and children clip to the parent's coords.
# But a label that reaches the border LOOKS wrong even when it is not clipped,
# and that is what gets reported as "it does not fit". So:
#     budget = button width - 8      (4 px of air each side)
#              - whatever the code concatenates onto the label
# Three real observations, all consistent with it (the labels as they were on
# 16/09/2026, before two of them were shortened):
#   "Étalonner maintenant"         206 px in 210  -> 2 px of air, reported
#   "Configurer dans le navigateur" 260 px in 216 -> clipped both ends, reported
# An id drawn in several widgets gets one row per widget. check() tests every
# row, and keeps comparing with German and English at the sites no row names.
# --- main screen status line (HDR_STATUS_W 292, narrow variant 262) ----------
# src/ui/main_screen.cpp:258, LV_LABEL_LONG_DOT. The narrow value is the one to
# respect: header_status.cpp:153 narrows it when the address shows a port.
# Only the ids really written to lbl_status are listed here.
# --- main screen, the big weight column (f20, no width) ----------------------
# lbl_spoolman_weight at x=8 (main_screen.cpp:527) has no width and runs until
# the divider at x=210, so 202 px. The status messages below replace the weight
# German "Fehler beim Speichern" is already 230 px here and crosses the divider.
# The gate keeps French from ever being wider than that.
# These have NO width set (LV_SIZE_CONTENT), so an over-long caption overlaps
# the next column instead of ellipsising - no warning at all. The budget is the
# gap to the neighbour, measured from the source coordinates. The Spoolman
# caption at x=8, y=189 is left out: it shows the backend's product name, which
